g.title: ER
g.text: 15 tables, grouped by role. One-to-many lines read parent (bar) to child (crow's foot); a circle means optional.

g.title: legend
g.text: All other columns are NOT NULL unless marked null.
created_by / uploaded_by / granted_by / signer_id also reference users.
Derived, never stored: clearance, user organisation, document department, latest version.
